Defined_Rx.NumberOfAntennas_comment: 1, 2, 3, 4. Used when Channel_Defects.json has any Mode set to 1: Decimate_Payload_Rx.py takes this many rays from File_Rx.Waveform_Payload_DefectsModeled_Rx. More than 1: steps 4-6 run per antenna (--ray N), Combine_Antennas_Rx.py combines them (MRC), steps 7-9 use the _Combined files. Run_Rx_Chain.py does it all.
Defined_Rx.NumberOfTxAntennas_comment: 1, 2. Transmit antennas, set from the control field (NoOfTxAntenna). Not the same as NumberOfAntennas (receive antennas)
Defined_Rx.ClientFlag_comment: Service, Client. Set from the control field
Defined_Rx.C_init_Dat_comment: 0 to 255. Gold code id that descrambles the payload. Set from the control field (C_init)
Defined_Rx.EqualizerMaxDoppler_comment: Hz, worst-case Doppler for the LMMSE and PCA time filter
Defined_Rx.ControlFieldEqualizerMode_comment: FIR8, EqualizerMode, LMMSE, LMMSE_LinearTime, PCA, Linear. Channel estimator for the control field (Process_Control_Field_Rx.py). FIR8 (default) = the FPGA receiver's fixed 8-tap LMMSE with drift-corrected linear time interpolation, so the simulator decodes the control field as the board does; EqualizerMode = use the payload's EqualizerMode
Defined_Rx.Use_Preamble_comment: 0 or 1. Default is 1. 0 does not attach the preamble for testing purposes
Defined_Rx.PacketDetThreshLo_comment: 0 to 1, below PacketDetThreshHi. Packet detector hysteresis: the detection flag clears when the comparison ratio falls below this. Default 0.2
Defined_Rx.PacketDetThreshHi_comment: 0 to 1, above PacketDetThreshLo. The detection flag sets when the comparison ratio rises above this. Lower = more sensitive, more false triggers. Default 0.45
Defined_Rx.PacketDetNormaliser_comment: Original, Bounded. Original = MATLAB ratio |autocorr| / variance (default). Bounded = |autocorr| / sqrt(variance x delayed variance), never above 1: removes the false trigger after a strong packet ends, and ignores the first SA_Len + 32 samples
Defined_Rx.PacketDetQualifier_comment: 0 to 512 samples (0, 32, 64, 128, 256 in the app). 0 = off (default, MATLAB). Otherwise the flag sets only after this many samples above PacketDetThreshHi. 128 with PacketDetThreshHi 0.35 detects at -12 dB without extra false triggers
Defined_Rx.CFOMethod_comment: FFT, Lag cascade. Frequency offset estimate from Preamble A in Packet_Detector.py. FFT = MATLAB method (4096-point FFT + lag-32 autocorrelation, default); Lag cascade = lags 16, 32, 128, 256 over 2048 samples, no FFT, about 0.9 kHz rms at -12 dB (FFT about 6 kHz)
Defined_Rx.DCBlocker_comment: 0 or 1. Default 1. Notch at 0 Hz (y = x - x[n-1] + (1 - 2^-10) y[n-1], corner about 3 kHz) on the 20 MHz stream before the preamble processing. Without it a receiver DC offset 10 dB below the noise triggers the packet detector
Defined_Rx.ToneCheckThresh_comment: dB, 0 = off. Default 13. Tone-structure check after the frequency estimate: the three weaker Preamble A tones must be this far above the noise. A DC offset or an interfering tone is a single tone and fails (packet aborted). Preamble A >= 14 dB down to -13 dB SNR (AWGN); interference <= 12.7 dB
Defined_Rx.TimingPeakThresh_comment: 0 = off, or the minimum peak/mean (|peak|^2 / mean |y|^2) of the Preamble B search; below it the packet is aborted (no peak in the search window). 18 from AWGN: correct peaks >= 20 at -14 dB, windows without Preamble B <= 15.4. Re-check with ETU. Not applied to Full Precision Taps
Defined_Rx.TimingMethod_comment: Full Precision Taps, 1-bit Taps, FFT method. Preamble B timing in Packet_Detector.py. Full Precision Taps = MATLAB 1140-tap matched filter (default); 1-bit Taps = same with taps quantised to +-1 +-j (adders only in hardware); FFT method = 1024-point FFT window search placed from the packet detection index
Defined_Rx.Use_ControlField_comment: 0 or 1. Default is 1. Must match the Tx. 1: Process_Control_Field_Rx.py decodes the control field after Packet_Detector.py, sets RefSymbolSpacing, RefSignalSpacing, PacketLength, Mod, NumberOfTxAntennas, EncoderBlockSize, EncoderCodeRate, Repetition and ClientFlag from it (running Initialize_Rx.py if any changed) and cuts it off the packet
